title: Panoptes Representation-Transport Card
description: Signed leave-one-cohort-out representation-transport result: each cohort is held out of both training and calibration, the detector is trained on the remaining cohorts and calibrated on source-calibration only, then applied frozen to the untouched target cohort. Deltas are against the seen source diagonal.

cells.description: Per-cohort LOCO cell. Each evaluable cell carries n_target, n_source_train, n_source_calibration, calibration_fit_on, a seen 'diagonal' metric block, an untouched 'target' metric block, and 'delta_from_diagonal'. Skipped cohorts carry {skipped, reason, n}.

summary.description: Aggregate over evaluable target cells: n_evaluable_cells, worst/mean cohort AUROC and Brier.
